annotations.title: Set a Google Ads campaign budget

description: Create a new daily budget, or change an existing budget’s daily amount (pass budgetResourceName). Raising the budget on a LIVE (ENABLED) campaign increases real spend immediately — you MUST show the user the new daily amount, get an explicit yes, then call with confirm:true. Creating a budget or lowering one on a paused campaign is safe.

budgetResourceName.description: existing budget to UPDATE — omit to CREATE a new budget

confirm.description: REQUIRED true to raise the budget of a LIVE campaign

customerId.description: 10-digit account id (dashes ok) — omit to use the brand’s selected default account

dailyBudgetUsd.description: daily budget in the ACCOUNT’s currency (historical name — not necessarily USD; 1–100000)

loginCustomerId.description: manager id if operating through an MCC

name.description: name for a newly created budget

name: set_google_ads_budget
